# Potamogeton × bennettii Fryer

First published in J. Bot. 33: 348 (1895)

This hybrid is accepted

The native range of this hybrid is W. Europe. It is a hydroannual or hydrosubshrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is P. crispus × P. trichoides.
